summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release dated September 20, 2022, reporting on August 2022 new residential construction. Relevant to the task: Table 5a details seasonally adjusted annual rates for housing completions by region (South, Northeast, Midwest) in thousands of units. This document contributes the specific data points for August 2022 (South: 674,000; Northeast: 125,000; Midwest: 200,000), covering the initial month of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. The data for August 2022 is marked preliminary (p), meaning it may be revised by subsequent reports in the collection, consistent with the task's precedence rule. It does not contain data for the remainder of the period (September 2022 through May 2025).

A joint U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (CB22-174) from October 19, 2022, on September 2022 residential construction. Relevant to the task: Table 5a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for new privately-owned housing units completed, segmented by region (South, Northeast, Midwest). This document contributes the specific completion figures required to evaluate the South versus combined Northeast/Midwest condition for the first two months of the requested period (August and September 2022). It notes that September data is preliminary and August data is revised, meaning these values are subject to potential revision by subsequent reports in the collection in accordance with the task's precedence rule. It does not cover the full 2022/08 to 2025/05 timeframe.
